questions.question: Explain the different forms of chemical signaling in multicellular organisms.
questions.solution_html:
• Chemical Signaling Forms
  • a. Endocrine: Hormones released into bloodstream (e.g., insulin).
  • b. Paracrine: Local signaling (e.g., neurotransmitters).
  • c. Autocrine: Cell signals itself.
  • d. Juxtacrine: Signaling via direct cell-cell contact.
questions.final_answer: Option Endocrine: Hormones released into bloodstream (e.g., insulin).
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
